comments.author: @akaTornSoul
comments.text: I know very little about AI training, so I have a question: Are the AI always completing tasks even when they aren't being asked to? Human's minds are non-stop engines. Even when we sleep it's doing things. We never stop thinking about random things, even if we don't want to. Then when we need to focus, there's a shift and we block out a lot of the extra input. Are AI trained in a similar way, or are they given a task, they complete it, on to the next pre-programmed task? I think a lot about how I think and wonder how close to that programmers are able to get, or because of the architecture, AI can't really process information that way?
